# HX Auto Service

> Car repair and maintenance service (Pusat Servis Kereta) in Taman Bukit Indah, Iskandar Puteri, Johor Bahru, Malaysia, close to the Second Link. Company no. 003403340-D.

- Address: 47 Jalan Indah 16/11, Taman Bukit Indah, 79100 Iskandar Puteri, Johor Bahru, Malaysia
- WhatsApp and phone: +60 11-6776 1138 (https://wa.me/601167761138)
- Opening hours (Google): Monday 09:30-19:30; Tuesday 09:30-19:30; Wednesday 09:30-19:30; Thursday 09:00-19:30; Friday 09:30-19:30; Saturday 09:30-19:30; Sunday closed
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/people/hx-auto-service/100084004382888/
- Waze: https://waze.com/ul/hw238qvq0m / Google Maps: https://g.co/kgs/8U4LfT
- Makes seen in the workshop: Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Toyota Alphard, Toyota Vellfire, Honda, Kia, Mazda, Mini, Subaru, Nissan, Lexus, Land Rover, Volkswagen
- Areas: Taman Bukit Indah, Iskandar Puteri, Johor Bahru

## Services
- [Computer diagnostics and coding](https://autoseo.my/preview/hx-auto/services/computer-diagnostics-coding/): Warning light on? We scan the car first.
- [Service and oil change](https://autoseo.my/preview/hx-auto/services/car-service-oil-change/): Engine oil, filter and a general check.
- [Engine and transmission](https://autoseo.my/preview/hx-auto/services/engine-transmission-repair/): Engine repair and transmission service.
- [Aircond](https://autoseo.my/preview/hx-auto/services/aircond-service/): Aircond service and flushing.
- [Brakes, suspension, tyres and alignment](https://autoseo.my/preview/hx-auto/services/brakes-suspension-tyres-alignment/): Stop, steer and ride right.
- [Battery and electrical](https://autoseo.my/preview/hx-auto/services/battery-electrical-repair/): Slow starts and electrical faults.
- [Undercarriage check](https://autoseo.my/preview/hx-auto/services/undercarriage-check/): A look underneath, on the lift.
- [Towing and recovery](https://autoseo.my/preview/hx-auto/services/towing-recovery/): Car will not move? Call us.

## Languages
English at the site root, Bahasa Melayu at /ms/, Simplified Chinese at /zh/. Every page exists in all three.
